notes: POC scope: Dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv) for 6 weeks; run production traffic shadowing first week
Primary workloads: chat support bot with long context (up to 4096 tokens), embeddings for doc search, reranking for suggested replies
Latency SLO: p95 120ms for short-chat (<=256 tokens); tail targets critical for UX
Throughput target: baseline 25 req/s, burst up to 75 req/s during support spikes
Cost sensitivity: mid; wants to understand cost delta hosted vs dedicated and quantization options
Model plan: prefer open Llama-family variants; fallback chain: v1-large -> v1-medium -> v1-small (lower-cost/latency), + open-source distilled model for non-critical routes
Routing/fallback: want canary routing (5% -> 20% -> 100%) then automatic fallback to medium variant on 5xx or p95 spike >200ms
Region plan: primary us-east-1; keep eu-west-1 for GDPR-sensitive traffic; failover for region outage required
Rollback triggers: >2% error rate sustained 3min, or p95 >250ms sustained 5min, or token cost >1.5x baseline
Canary policy: stepwise weight ramp, manual gate at 20% for 24h, auto-roll back on thresholds above
Acceptance criteria for POC: meet p95 targets at baseline throughput, no data exfil reports in security scan, cost estimate aligned with forecast
Security asks: SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs retention 12 months, ability to pin model versions
